safety: Hardware initialization configures the IO expander and asserts amplifier and DAC mute before powering the DSP or initializing the DAC.
Unmute requests are denied unless the process is explicitly started with --allow-unmute.
Shutdown attempts to remute both physical outputs.
The service exposes no MCU upgrade, flash, MTD, or persistent-storage path.
validation: Pinned Go 1.18 tests and go vet passed.
Two static ARMv7 builds were byte-identical.
The live service initialized the physical expander and DAC and remained muted.
Amplifier and DAC mute procedures succeeded; an unmute request was rejected by default policy.
Static analysis of the donor heartbeat handler proved opcode 0x24 is sent every five seconds and leaves the other five frame bytes unspecified.
Sending 24 00 00 00 00 00 every five seconds prevented the reset observed when the heartbeat was absent.
The physical rotary ring produced volumeup step 1 and volumedown steps 2 and 1 through the owned WAMP service.
The target remained connected over USB after the bidirectional rotary test.
